title: Answer: consciousness emerges where world models gain coherence

statements.text: Consciousness, systems themselves and causation at larger scales are emergent. IWMT treats FEP-AI and IIT together as models of emergent causation, and experience emerges when synchronous complexes integrate a generative model into a world coherent in space, time and cause.

sources.quote: I further describe how an integration of these frameworks may contribute to their evolution as unified systems theories and models of emergent causation
